empresa.title: Company
empresa.text: APS Filtros was established in 1981, initially to manufacture and market "membrane-type" filter elements for the agricultural sector (milk processing control - laboratory / lactofiltration / soluble coffee and sugarcane molasses analysis), paints and varnishes (in press filter / sparkler equipment), later expanding to serve other disposable product segments as well as distribution of double-sided cotton tape.

disleite.title: Lentini Disc - Disleite
disleite.desc: Discs for milk, soluble coffee or other liquid analysis. Boxes with 100 units of "APS" type - DISLEITE brand - Ø=31.7 mm or 1 ¼". Used in the minit filter (also known as lactofiltro) for the milk filtration test, a lab procedure that measures insoluble sediment — dust, hair and other particles — in raw milk, indicating the hygienic conditions of milking. Also used for analysis of soluble coffee, sugarcane molasses and other liquids.

camisas.title: Filter Sleeves
camisas.desc: Sleeve-type filters, sewn. Boxes or packages with 100 pieces in various dimensions. Application: mechanical milking machines and others.

industrial.title: Products - Industrial
industrial.subtitle: Filtration for paint, varnish, and vegetable oil industries

resinas.title: Resin Clarification
resinas.desc: Paint industry chain for resin clarification, used in sparkler-type filters.

membranas.title: Circular Filter Membranes
membranas.desc: Filter paper or non-woven fabric (industrial filters). Boxes and/or packages with 100 pieces, used in sparkler or press-type filters. Application: filtration of resins and varnishes in paint and varnish industries and/or filtration and clarification of liquids in vegetable oil industries and others.

fitas.title: Double-Sided Tape
fitas.desc: Distribution of yellow cotton double-sided "strong" tape, various sizes available upon request, with 30.00 m length for diverse applications such as hair extensions.
